title: castanopsis costata
intro: Castanopsis costata, commonly known as the Chinese chestnut oak, is a species of tree in the family Fagaceae. This plant is used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Castanopsis costata include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and improving respiratory function, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Castanopsis costata are responsible for its medicinal properties, making it a valuable plant in traditional Chinese medicine.
